name: Lux Blue
note: Clean scheduling-app blue & white, finished with luxury restraint (navy depth, platinum hairlines, film grain). Original palette - no third-party logos or names.
rules: Max two type styles per frame: Anton uppercase for punch words, Playfair italic for connective/luxury words.
Electric blue is an accent: one highlighted word or one button per frame, never full backgrounds.
Platinum only for hairlines, labels and checkmarks.
Motion is eased (expo/quint out), never linear or bouncy. Slow drift on backgrounds, fast reveals on type.
Always add grain (3-5%) and a soft vignette - flat digital black reads cheap.
